items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: I ain't never had, I never did play with him in my life, but just stand up and look at him and play.

ctx.x: Anything else about the old-time clarinetist you can tell about T.O. any more about how he played? Did he read a good deal, too? T.O.? Oh, oh, oh. Did he play a lot of jazz, too?

He played all kind of ways. That's about the, that is about, when I say, why I put him so high because he played at E flat, he played the B flat, he done a lot more singing than Piku. People might use the name of the B kooze all right, but that fella was a, and he was so clean. Oh, he was a clean clarinet player. I ain't never had, I never did play with him in my life, but just stand up and look at him and play. You know when something's nice, why you got to do this stand up?
